description: This file contains functions and logic for staging media files in a sandbox environment, including handling local and remote files, path resolution, permission checks, and SCP file transfer.

methods.name: stageSandboxMedia
methods.description: Main function to stage media files into a sandbox or remote cache, handling local and remote sources, path resolution, and path rewriting.

methods.name: stageLocalFileIntoRoot
methods.description: Copies a local file into the specified root directory with size check.

methods.name: stageRemoteFileIntoRoot
methods.description: Downloads a remote file via SCP and stages it into the specified root directory.

methods.name: resolveRawPaths
methods.description: Resolves media paths from context, handling array or single string input.

methods.name: resolveAbsolutePath
methods.description: Converts a file URL or relative path to an absolute path, or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: isAllowedSourcePath
methods.description: Checks if a source path is allowed based on inbound path policies and sandbox restrictions.

methods.name: allocateStagedFileName
methods.description: Generates a unique filename for staging, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: rewriteStagedMediaPaths
methods.description: Rewrites media paths in context to point to staged locations.

methods.name: scpFile
methods.description: Performs SCP transfer of a remote file to a local path.
